_readme: the shop catalog — shop.html renders it, netlify/functions/checkout.mjs prices from it (the browser never sends a price). amounts are cents. shipping per order = region.first + region.additional × (total units − 1); a product's units default to 1 (heavier things, e.g. vinyl, count more). draft products only render off the production host (or with ?drafts) and only sell against a Stripe TEST key. soldOut: true for the whole product, or a list of options. images: paths under assets/shop/.
